question: 1. Artur (Sponsor) is ready to provide funds for the SnakeBite game. What official role does he play in the Project Management Team?
explanation: The Executive represents the business and is the single point of accountability for the project. It is determined by business; this accountability CANNOT be delegated.

question: 2. Maya represents players and ensures that the game controls are intuitive. What is her role on the Project Board?
explanation: The lead user(s) represents the user community and is accountable for the approach to capturing user requirements and benefit specifications aligned with the business case.

question: 3. Kamil manages an external company. providing the graphics engine. Responsible for the quality of suppliers' code. Who is on the Board?
explanation: The primary supplier(s) is accountable for the quality of the products delivered by the suppliers AND for the technical integrity of the project.

question: 4. Zosia has too much work creating reports. Appoints a person to keep archives and registers. What is this support role called?
explanation: Project Support helps PMs with administration, records and tools.

question: 5. Artur asks if he can combine the role of Executive and Project Manager to 'save on full-time employment'. What does Zosia say?
options: NO! The roles of Executive and Project Manager (PM) CANNOT be combined into one person.
explanation: The Project Manager CANNOT be a member of the Project Board or act as an Executive. The Levels of Management and Direction must be separated.

question: 6. Who is responsible for independently checking for the Project Board whether the work is carried out properly (Project Assurance - Project Assurance)?
options: Members of the Project Board (or independent persons designated by them).
explanation: Board members are accountable for the oversight of their areas. They may appoint separate people for oversight tasks, but not PMs, team members or Project Support.

question: 7. Artur wants to give Zosia responsibility for the project while remaining Executive. Can he do it?
options: Yes, if I put it in the role description.
No - Executive accountability for the project cannot be delegated.
explanation: The project executive is the single point of accountability for the project. This accountability CANNOT be delegated.

question: 8. Maya describes the benefits of SnakeBite. What should they be matched with?
options: With a list of Project Support tools.
explanation: The Senior User is accountable for the approach to capturing user requirements and benefit specifications aligned with the business case.

question: 9. The engine works independently, but does not cooperate with the rest of the game. For which area is Kamil also responsible as a Senior Supplier?
options: For the administration of all registers.
For the technical integrity of the project.
explanation: The quality of supplier products does not exhaust the Senior Supplier role: it also covers the technical integrity of the project.

question: 10. Zosia gives Tom the implementation of the achievement system. How should she assign this work?
options: Through the description of the work package, with agreed specifications and tolerances.
By giving him the responsibility of the Executive.
By asking him to set the project tolerances himself.
explanation: The project manager assigns work in the form of a work package description in accordance with the Commercial management approach. The team manager performs it within the agreed tolerances.

question: 11. Zosia and Tomek agree on when changes can be made at an internal meeting. Do such arrangements need to be secured?
options: No, because Tomek is not an external supplier.
No, if no contract has been signed.
Yes - also informal arrangements with colleagues.
explanation: The Project Manager secures ALL project arrangements, both formal contracts and informal internal arrangements.

question: 12. The Board wants to entrust the supervision of the project to the person keeping the registers as Project Support. Is this appropriate?
options: No - Project Support cannot perform Project Assurance.
Yes, because he knows the registers.
Yes, if Zosia has no objections.
Yes, if it is done outside working hours.
explanation: Project supervision cannot be delegated to the Project Manager, team members or Project Support.

question: 13. PixelBite Games has not designated a separate person to support the project. Who is responsible for these tasks by default?
options: Nobody until a project office is established.
explanation: Project support remains the responsibility of the Project Manager by default; may be delegated or established as a project office.

question: 14. Zosia keeps track of costs and deadlines. Which set covers all 7 areas he manages?
options: Costs, time, marketing, sales, law, HR, purchasing.
Benefits, costs, time, risk, quality, scope, sustainability.
Budget, programming, testing, graphics, sound, advertising, recruitment.
explanation: The project manager manages seven areas, including benefits and sustainability, within agreed tolerances and constraints.
